censoring.note: Primary includes censored late rows for seed comparability; mature and fixed-90-day results are separate. December has zero follow-up.

data_quality.difference: Exclude snapshot in_kev=1 even when the frozen catalog disagrees. This removes a high-ranked unlabelled row and changes the exploit-first top-500 cutoff.

story.title: A separate watch list for the blind spot
story.sentence: Prior product history marked 15 of 31 blind-spot positives but only 15.9% of the no-signal pool, a descriptive review cue; the preregistered watch model still found none in 500 reviews, so the 2026 queue remains exploratory.

story.title: Two catalog clocks
story.sentence: Of 165 KEV-listed vulnerabilities published in 2025, 110 were already listed by publication-month end, while the other 55 took a median 45 days from publication to listing—a catalog delay, not a first-attack timestamp.

story.title: Vendor history separates public-tool rows
story.sentence: Within the public-tool tier, vendors with at least 20 prior KEV entries had 6 later additions among 138 rows (4.35%), versus 7 among 589 with no matched history (1.19%), an exploratory association subject to text-revision and matching risk.

story.title: Learning to order the public-tool tier
story.sentence: In the 2025 development backtest, the selected ranking found 22 of 55 later additions in its first 500 rows versus 19 for exploit-first, and 21 versus 17 at the equal-workload budget of 331; its 2026 outcome remains unknown.

top500_profile_2026.note: CWE and CVSS in the display CSV are current descriptive metadata and do not enter the strict model.

policy.pool: All four snapshot flags and any_exploit equal zero; missing monthly observations follow the existing zero-flag tier rule.
policy.inner_train: 2024 publication cohorts with at least 90 days follow-up at 2024-06-30 (January–March).
policy.selection: Largest sum of validation hits at 100, 250 and 500; then validation average precision; then no embedding, logistic, name.
policy.fixed_parameters: Existing logistic C=0.2 or sparse LightGBM: 160 trees, 7 leaves, depth 3, min leaf 40, Hessian 0.05; no tuning.
policy.features: Exact-month EPSS and percentile, publication timing, prior vendor/product/assigner KEV counts, sanitized keywords; optional pinned Granite description embeddings with train-only PCA.
policy.excluded: Constant tool flags/counts; all current CWE/CVSS fields, enrichment/status/counts/references, undated ransomware annotations and raw incident claims.
policy.encoder_timing: The frozen encoder was released by 2024 year-end, before 2025 evaluation; 2024 validation is retrospective recipe development, not a simulated live 2024 deployment.
policy.test_primary: Fit mature no-signal 2024 rows with labels through 2024-12-31; score all 2025 publication cohorts once, outcomes through 2025-12-31.
policy.test_secondary: Same chosen recipe, refit mature no-signal 2024+early-2025 rows with labels through 2025-06-30; score July–September 2025.
policy.test_use: 2025 cannot change recipes, hyperparameters, selection, or production seed; all selected-model seeds are diagnostics only.
policy.censoring: Training requires 90 days observation; primary includes immature late-2025 cohorts and reports their counts. Secondary has at least 90 days. Non-membership is unobserved exploitation, not safety.
policy.bootstrap: 1000 paired month resamples, fixed fitted scores, literal budgets 100/250/500, seed 2026; also show workload-fraction sensitivity.
policy.mixed_allocation: Report pure frozen top500, 450 exploit-tier plus 50 watch, and 400 plus 100; do not change submission.
policy.final_fit: Mature no-signal 2024+2025 rows; labels through 2025-12-31; seed 2026 regardless of test results.
policy.unavailable_2023: No 2023 monthly signals were supplied; no backfill from 2024.
policy.negative_result: Publish the same watch artifact and an explicit negative result if the chosen recipe catches no held-out positives.

definitions.assigner_type: A match to a prior-KEV vendor PSIRT domain is only a proxy; unresolved domains and UUIDs are not asserted to be non-vendor CNAs.

limitations: Descriptive 2025 contrasts do not select or modify the watch model.
CWE and vector/score fields are current enrichment with high timing risk; they are excluded from watch features.
Product classes use the first matching wording category, not verified asset identity; descriptions may have changed.

The product-level enrichment and absence of vendor-level enrichment were selected after inspecting the complete profile; these are exploratory contrasts, not preregistered causal tests, and they never alter the model.
Lag measures catalog addition, not the first attack. Late-year non-events remain censored.

limitations: Only three training positives and eight validation positives in the inner 2024 split.

The shared feature family was developed in earlier work that inspected 2025 results. This round freezes the watch recipes before their 2025 evaluation; it does not create a wholly untouched project-wide holdout.
The two 2025 evaluation sets overlap; the secondary is a later-cutoff refit, not independent replication.
Random expectation is below one hit at every tested budget; zero observed hits shows no demonstrated gain, not proof that the pool has no learnable signal.
No flag includes missing snapshot observations; it does not prove exploit code was absent.
Current sanitized description wording and heuristic identity retain revision/matching risk.
Current CWE/CVSS data are descriptive only and cannot justify a time-safe predictive gain.
The main submission is frozen; mixed allocations are comparisons for a separate decision.
